purpose: Repeat matched J0 reachability and J2 recovery validation with filtered torque noise.
limitations: This is a model-level Python plant experiment and does not validate a physical robot.
The validation scenarios were used previously and are not an independent blind test.
The 1.5 N·m Gaussian noise is applied to the fault-joint torque sensor reading only.
Docker was unavailable during this turn, so this dataset contains no new online ROS 2 or MQTT runs.
Full CSV traces for all 72 runs remain in the ignored local reports directory. Four representative V2 traces are included here for replay.
